context: Riku and Aoi talk about a sad movie.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ひどい/逃げ/ほんとう/聴く/ブルー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あの映画、ほんとう泣けたよ。
lines.en: That movie really made me cry.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 主人公、ひどい目に遭ってたよね。
lines.en: The hero went through a terrible time.
lines.style: soft barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 逃げずに、立ち向かったのが良かった。
lines.en: He faced it without fleeing — that was good.
lines.style: admiring teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 音楽も、ブルーで切なかったね。
lines.en: The music was blue and bittersweet too.
lines.style: gentle barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: サントラ、もう一回聴きたいな。
lines.en: I want to listen to the soundtrack again.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 聴くと、また泣いちゃいそう。
lines.en: Listening to it, I might cry again.
lines.style: soft barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとう、いい映画だったね。
lines.en: It really was a good movie.
lines.style: warm teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ブルーだけど、心に残る作品だね。
lines.en: Blue, but a work that stays with you.
lines.style: gentle barista voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
